bottleneck.description: World's second-largest silicon-wafer maker (300mm prime and epitaxial wafers), the substrate under essentially all leading-edge logic and memory.

dependency.key_customers: NXP, Infineon, SK Hynix, major Taiwanese foundries

editorial.notes: Prime 300mm wafers are made at scale by only about five firms, and Shin-Etsu with SUMCO account for roughly half the market, so the concentration is a tight oligopoly rather than a monopoly. Every advanced logic, AI and HBM device starts on one of these wafers, making the volume dependence total, but customers deliberately multi-source and a credible named second source, Shin-Etsu, is qualified at every fab, even though switching carries multi-quarter to multi-year qualification. This is the same structure as Shin-Etsu, which is already rated MEDIUM, so SUMCO rates MEDIUM for parity. Clean operating entity with no export-control choke-point role.
